notes.title: Two years of NQA!
notes.notes:
No Questions Asked is celebrating its second anniversary today!!!
To mark the occasion, we wanted to upload one last major update and say a few candid words.

As part of today's update, we are fixing some minor bugs.... but there’s no point dwelling on that, as we also have something far more exciting to share with you! Namely, the game is being expanded with Ukrainian and Russian localization, which includes not only the texts in the game proper, but also achievements, their descriptions, and the Steam storefront. We would not have been able to do this without the help of our translators - Yakub Pervinenko and Oleg Ushakov, who out of sheer passion expressed their willingness to help us translate the prepared texts, for which we sincerely thank you!

With this update, we’re wrapping up our main plans for No Questions Asked. And with that, we extend our heartfelt thanks to everyone who was with us during the development of the game, as well as after the release. Thank you for your words of support, criticism, ideas on how some things can be improved or changed, help with testing, text revisions, and—once again—translations. Thanks also to all those on the Internet who nudged us to do anything to promote the game or our group, and have also reached out to us themselves to help with this through short recordings, posts or other walkthroughs.

Most importantly, we want to thank you - the Players. For all the good and negative words about the game, from which we were able to learn. For recommending the game to your friends, for the reviews, for the forum posts, for the recordings of the game, for listening to the soundtrack, for the created guides. It is with great pleasure that we often return to them and reading or watching these things always brings a smile to our faces.

When we first sat down to design the NQA prototype, our priority was to pass a university course for which we were making the said game.... Not once did we imagine that soon after, this project could be available on Steam and face such a positive response! You are the best, thank you!

Keep it up!
Jakub & Aleks

PS: While we have finished our adventure with Courier, we still have a little insight into the very world presented in NQA, which we will be sharing with you in the form of free DLC! We're also expanding the game's soundtrack with [url=https://soundcloud.com/jakub-emski/closing-time?si=373c5d2f581d40689be4652c4b6a02ce&utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing]a new track[/url]!

notes.title: Untitled
notes.notes:
Ironed out several typos and text errors.

Cheers!

notes.title: Bugs, begone!
notes.notes:
Hark!

Several things have been tweaked:
- loading a specific Day save file from main menu no longer traps you forever in a time loop
- fixed a graphical bug allowing the player to clip behind a wall after Bitcoin Baron's delivery
- fixed a duplicate line in the Polish localisation of the cat interaction
- opening content warning screen is now skippable via pressing any key
- object outlines won't appear whilst the dialogue's active
- tweaked the movement tutorial so that it appears instantly on the first day (and you don't have to actually, you know, move for that to happen ;p )
- fixed an issue where a certain gun wouldn't be drawn before being shot

Have a great day!

notes.notes:

- fixed a typo in Polish localisation
- fixed an issue which led to duplicate clues spawning on the Pinboard

notes.title: Hotfix to the last patch!
notes.notes:
- fixed an issue with the day not advancing when wrapping up some days
- readded two missing background NPCs at the Attorney's

notes.title: Giga-Patch 1.1.6
notes.notes:
Hello!
This update is probably the last major content addition to the game, and focuses on enhancing the player experience:

- Added a brand new Pinboard interface, on which you may rearrange gathered clues, as well as tag them as [b]true[/b], [b]false[/b], and [b]plausible[/b]. This interface is accessible via clicking on the, uh, pinboard in your office and replaces the old, list-based interface

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43373986/15cd99d8ee60ea41d7170ddb9e7594dc019556eb.png[/img]

- Added a brand new City Map interface that's used for navigating between available scenes. This interface replaces the old and boring list of available locations, and is accessible through walking to the current scene exit, or pressing [b]TAB[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43373986/a02c58f3f93240d2974a2e0edbcce8efe40ced13.png[/img]

- Expanded the save system, so that apart from an autosave in each scene, the game creates a separate savefile at the beginning of each day. When loading game from the menu, you can now choose the savefile to load. 

- Changed the way tutorial popups work, so that they disappear only after walking away from their trigger, not after a set amount of time (so you don't have to worry about not reading them in time!)

- Changed the highlight colour of dialogue options, for better contrast and visibility, as well as...

- ...Implemented the option to browse available dialogue option using navigation keys (you can select a highlighted option via [b]E[/b], [b]Enter[/b], or [b]Space[/b])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43373986/cd542226815571c51884088a38d9cc5862bbc282.png[/img]

- Fixed some mistakes in text

- Replaced in-game references to No █████ ████████ with No Questions Asked.

Thank you for all the suggestions and bug-hunting! This update largely came to be because of your feedback

Cheers

notes.title: Fix to the weird audio bug (1.1.53)!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all the people who described any issues with the game, it's all immensely helpful in getting NSU in proper shape! In this patch, we tracked down the possible culprit behind audio volume defaulting to 0%, it should be fine now. Additionally, the issue with Attorney at Crime not unlocking on Day 4 has been fixed a few days ago, but wasn't mentioned in a post, so letting you all know it should work at intended now!

Cheerio!

notes.title: Hotfix to the last patch
notes.notes:
- made sure audio setting should default to full
- adapted the elevator & packages interactions so that they can be done without clicking on them (a leftover from when the game was solely mouse-controlled)
- tweaked one minor interaction at Tobey's

notes.title: Bug squashes and tweaks (1.1.5)
notes.notes: - fixed some mistakes in text - clicking to close the dialogue window no longer causes the character to move - holding the mouse button down during camera panning transitions shouldn't cause the character to try and go back to the previous screen - fixed an issue where spending a certain amount of time at Tobey's could cause the Finish. button to double if the dialogue window was already open - fixed an issue with some clues being saved twice - added an option in the main menu to contact the devs directly - added a dialogue choice to pet the cat ᓚᘏᗢ have a great day!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.4 is out now!
notes.notes:
Hi! Some work has been done:
- Added keyboard controls (wsad and arrows) to navigate in-scenes
- Added the option to quickly pop up scene transition menu (by pressing TAB), if it's possible to leave the current scene (and added a notification if it's not)
- Tweaked some camera panning zone options
- Added game logo to the credits, cause we just now realized it wasn't already there

Cheerio!

notes.title: Bugfixes and QoL additions (1.1.3)!
notes.notes:
- Fixed some issues with clue object interactions that led to possible endless dialogue finish button generation
- Added the possibility to close dialogue window / advance dialogue (if there's only one dialogue choice available); just press spacebar or click anywhere on the screen that's not a button!

notes.title: Quick patch 1.1.2!
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where unpausing the game might have, ironically, frozen the game.

Cheers

notes.title: We're live!
notes.notes:
It's on, No Stone Unturned is out!

Cheerio!

notes.title: No Stone Unturned launching on January 9!
notes.notes:
Hi there!

We're happy to announce that NSU has a set release date - January 9, so two weeks from now. Frankly, we can't wait to share this fun little passion project with all of you! 

Much love and happy holidays,
TTC
